Combine the oats or cooked grain with the measured milk, yogurt or water, if listed. Warm gently for 3–5 minutes when a hot porridge is wanted, or chill overnight for oats. Add sliced fruit, spices and measured nuts or seeds. Serve cooked eggs, bread or vegetables alongside when listed.

Use cooked chicken heated to 74°C, ground beef to 71°C, fish and shrimp to 63°C, and eggs with firm whites and yolks. Reheat leftovers to 74°C; refrigerate promptly. Only add the ingredients and oil listed if you want the shown nutrient estimate.
source: Original Forma home-style recipe; USDA SR Legacy ingredient nutrition, April 2018.
